# Node-API headers

Unmodified public headers from Node.js v24.12.0, https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/v24.12.0/src.
`LICENSE` is the upstream license. These headers compile the main-process addon
against Node-API v8, a stable ABI; no V8 or Electron internals are linked.
The addon transfers existing DMA-BUF descriptors over a private inherited socket.
